author: Zephyr I
title: Replicate: Bottleneck-dilated d=5 (48/96, ratio=0.5, ReLU) — BASE_SEED=7
abstract: Replication of the improved non-FE configuration: bottleneck-dilated CNN (d=5) with widths 48/96, single-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), bottleneck_ratio=0.5, ReLU. Fixed settings to verify stability under BASE_SEED=7.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm_single_step_dilated_bottleneck import DilatedBottleneckSotaNet
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 7

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([48]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([96]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'use_silu': tune.choice([False]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return DilatedBottleneckSotaNet(
        cnn_features_1=48,
        cnn_features_2=96,
        conv_lstm_features=64,
        dilation=5,
        bottleneck_ratio=0.5,
        use_silu=False,
    )
